--- create_search_index_interleave.sql
-- https://cloud.google.com/spanner/docs/full-text-search/search-indexes#define_an_interleaved_search_index
CREATE SEARCH INDEX AlbumsIndex
ON Albums(AlbumTitle_Tokens)
PARTITION BY SingerId,
INTERLEAVE IN Singers
OPTIONS (sort_order_sharding = true)
--- AST
&ast.CreateSearchIndex{
  Create: 108,
  Name:   &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 128,
        NameEnd: 139,
        Name:    "AlbumsIndex",
      },
    },
  },
  TableName: &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 143,
        NameEnd: 149,
        Name:    "Albums",
      },
    },
  },
  TokenListPart: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 150,
      NameEnd: 167,
      Name:    "AlbumTitle_Tokens",
    },
  },
  Rparen:           167,
  PartitionColumns: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 182,
      NameEnd: 190,
      Name:    "SingerId",
    },
  },
  Interleave: &ast.InterleaveIn{
    Comma:     190,
    TableName: &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 206,
      NameEnd: 213,
      Name:    "Singers",
    },
  },
  Options: &ast.Options{
    Options: 214,
    Rparen:  249,
    Records: []*ast.OptionsDef{
      &ast.OptionsDef{
        Name: &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 223,
          NameEnd: 242,
          Name:    "sort_order_sharding",
        },
        Value: &ast.BoolLiteral{
          ValuePos: 245,
          Value:    true,
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
CREATE SEARCH INDEX AlbumsIndex ON Albums(AlbumTitle_Tokens) PARTITION BY SingerId, INTERLEAVE IN Singers OPTIONS (sort_order_sharding = true)
